hkia.title: Chapter 1: Landing at HKIA
hkia.description: Survive the airport arrival, grab an Octopus card, and catch a red urban taxi.

section_01_taxi.title: Hailing a Red Taxi
section_01_taxi.description: Learn key phrases to flag down a taxi and give directions to the driver.

card_taxi_001.translation: Excuse me, pull over on the side please.
card_taxi_001.contextualHint: Use right before your designated destination building.

success.headline: True Hongkonger Speed!
success.subtext: The taxi driver understood your directions instantly and nodded. Perfect tones.

warning.headline: The English Pivot
warning.subtext: The driver understood after a brief pause, then replied in English to confirm. Your accent gave you away.

danger.headline: Complete Blank Stare
danger.subtext: The driver smiled politely and pointed at the meter. Your tones missed completely.
